title: Code Migration Agent
subtitle: Framework, version and language migrations, for every stack: analyse here, then let a Kanban task make the change.

results.unsupportedHint: The rule-based planner does not know this pair. The Kanban task still applies it: the agents plan it for the project stack and run its checks.
